Name: (CP) Dogs as Farm Animals
Author: suushiico
Description:
[center][size=6][b][/b][/size]This mod is no longer being maintained. I give anyone permission to build upon any of my Stardew Valley mods, including re-use of any assets and code. I still ask that you do not repost to other websites! Please feel free to go in and fix the bugs, add more content, change it completely, etc.

Adds dogs as a livestock option. Dogs dig up bone fragments and artifacts![/center]
[b][size=6]Installation
[/size][/b]
You must already have the most up-to-date versions of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] in order to run this mod.
You must be running SDV version 1.6+.

Download the .zip file under [i]Files[/i] and extract the contents to your Mods folder.


[size=6][b]FAQ
[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Where can I purchase dogs as livestock?
[/b][/size]Like other livestock, you can purchase them from Marnie's Ranch!

[size=4][b]What breeds are included?
[/b][/size]All 6 forms of the vanilla dog breeds are included.

[size=4][b]When will dogs dig up artifacts?
[/b][/size]Artifacts are a deluxe drop, so your dog must have at least 1 heart (200 friendship points) before it has a chance to dig them up. Mostly, dogs will be digging up bone fragments!

[size=4][b]Is this mod configurable?
[/b][/size][size=2]Yes! You can configure the mod (I recommend using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]).

[/size][size=4][b]What mods are you using in the screenshots?
[/b][/size][list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4]CJB Cheats Menu[/url]﻿

[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255]DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolour﻿[/url]﻿
[/list]
[size=4][b]Any other recommended mods?
[/b][/size]Yes! I also created [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23905](CP) Junimos as Farm Animals[/url]﻿ which adds Junimos as a livestock option (Junimos drop seasonal crops daily), and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22992](CP) Cats as Farm Animals[/url] which adds cats as a livestock option (cats drop fish daily).
